description.value:
You channel disruptive force lightning into your weapon. As part of casting this power, you must make a melee weapon attack against a creature within your reach, or the power fails. On a hit, the attack deals its normal damage, and the lightning arcs to a second creature of your choice within 5 feet of the target, dealing lightning damage equal to your forcecasting ability modifier.

At 5th level, the melee attack instead deals an extra 1d8 lightning damage, and the arcing damage becomes 1d8 plus your forcecasting ability modifier; both rolls grow by an additional 1d8 at 11th level and again at 17th level.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Dark Side Powers, At-Will
